title: People’s Mañanera August 10
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**More Education and Critical Thinking to Counter Digital Excesses  
** President Claudia Sheinbaum called for protecting children from social
media and AI. Sixteen of the country's 32 states already regulate cell phone
use in schools. The focus is on education, not prohibition. What is needed is
critical thinking, reading, social interaction, and regulation of platforms so
that technology serves the people, not controls them.

**Mexico 's Solidarity with the People of Colombia  
**In response to the earthquake in Colombia, Mexico remains vigilant through
diplomatic channels and reiterated its willingness to provide support. "All
the support needed, if necessary, (will be provided) for the people of
Colombia--we will be there," the President announced.

**A National Campaign to Plant the Future  
** Sheinbaum thanked state governors, the Armed Forces, Civil Protection
agencies, firefighters, those involved in reforesting, and citizens for
participating in National Reforestation Day, held this Sunday throughout the
country.

**Our History Is Told Through the Peoples  
** The President called for renaming Paso de Cortes to Paso de los Pueblos
Indigenas. "This has to do with whom we honor and whom we do not," Sheinbaum
explained. She called for a historical narrative that stops glorifying the
conquistadors and recognizes the dignity and greatness of Indigenous peoples.

**Dialogue and Security to Protect Mexico 's Rural Areas  
**It was reported that 45 avocado packing plants have already resumed
operations following the suspension of activities announced by the United
States in Michoacan. More than 60 packing plants are still awaiting the
resumption of operations.

**Water for the Eastern Part of the Valley of Mexico and Key Solutions  
** The President announced a comprehensive project for the eastern part of the
Valley of Mexico. Measures include replacing wells that cause ground
subsidence and bringing water from Cuautitlan Izcalli to Iztapalapa. Funding
for Line A of the Mexico City metro and the Lecheria-Felipe Ángeles
International Airport (AIFA) train line are also being reviewed.

**Mexico Flies Its Flag High  
** Sheinbaum congratulated Mexican athletes for their participation in the
2026 Central American and Caribbean Games. "They flew the national flag high,"
she declared. The results will be presented, and support for Mexican sports
will continue to be strengthened.
